newsitem.title: USA: U.S domestic auto sales up 3.3 pct Oct 21-31 -- CNW.
newsitem.headline: U.S domestic auto sales up 3.3 pct Oct 21-31 -- CNW.

text.p: U.S. domestic automobile sales increased 3.3 percent in the last 10 days of October compared with the same period a year ago, according to a CNW Marketing/Research auto sales report released on Monday.
Domestic car sales increased to 239,109 in the 10-day survey period, up from 236,814 in the same period of 1995, CNW said. Import car sales rose to 60,558 from 59,381, CNW said.
Domestic truck sales climbed to 186,136 in end-October 1996 from 174,810 end-October 1995, the report said. Import truck sales rose to 16,924 from 16,268, it said.
CNW said 30.8 percent of the vehicles were leased, down from 32.7 percent in the same survey period last year.
About 12.89 million vehicles were sold in the United States from January through October 1996, CNW said.
